objective: Al terminar demuestras el nivel A2: hablas de tu vida, das opiniones con razones, describes cómo haces las cosas y usas los tiempos verbales aprendidos.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint final de A2: integra adverbios, verbos + -ing / to, opiniones, conectores y tu historia de vida.

input.recap_es: Repasa: adverbios de modo, verbos + -ing o to + verbo, dar y pedir opiniones, because / so / but / although y cómo contar tu vida con varios tiempos.

explanation.md_es:
**Repaso de la unidad 10**

- *carefully · slowly · well · hard · fast* — *He speaks English well.*
- *enjoy / finish / mind + -ing · want / hope / decide + to + verbo*
- *I think … · In my opinion … · I agree / I don't agree · I don't think …*
- *because · because of · so · but · although*
- *I was born … · I've lived here for … · Next year I'm going to … · One day I'd like to …*

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! El adverbio de good es well.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: El adverbio de good es well.

exercises.prompt: He drives ___ because the road is icy. (con cuidado)
I don't ___ that it's a good idea. (no creo)
It was raining, ___ we stayed at home. (así que)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: So introduce el resultado.

options: Although it was late, we went out.
Although it was late, but we went out.
Although it was late, so we went out.
Because it was late, but we went out.
answer: Although it was late, we went out.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Although no se combina con but.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Although no se combina con but.

options: I was born in 1995 and I've lived here since 2019.
I am born in 1995 and I live here since 2019.
I born in 1995 and I've lived here for 2019.
I was born in 1995 and I live here since 2019.
answer: I was born in 1995 and I've lived here since 2019.

exercises.audio_text: I think that learning English is useful because I can travel more easily. Although it's difficult, I enjoy studying every day.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'I enjoy studying every day'.

exercises.prompt: Creo que es una buena idea porque es barato, aunque es un poco lejos.
answer: I think it's a good idea because it's cheap, although it's a bit far.
I think it is a good idea because it is cheap, although it is a bit far.
I think it's a good idea because it's cheap, although it's a little far.

exercises.prompt: Escribe un párrafo de 6 a 8 frases presentándote como si fuera el final de A2: de dónde eres, qué hiciste, qué haces ahora, qué opinas de aprender inglés y qué quieres hacer en el futuro.
self_check_es: ¿Hablaste del futuro (going to / I'd like to)?
exercises.model_answer: I was born in Santa Fe and I studied business. I've worked in an office for two years. I enjoy working with people, but I'm not very good at maths. I think that English is important because I want to travel. Although it's difficult, I study every day. Next year I'm going to take a course, and one day I'd like to work abroad.
